solution_summary: To do so, the company needed a cloud provider built for global scale and rapid innovation that could support growth, all while handling the platform's large, seasonal spikes in traffic. GoWish chose to build its new platform on Google Cloud . This was both for its global reach and the tight integration between its data and AI ecosystem, which would give GoWish the agility to develop new features quickly. Just as important, though, was the relationship with the Google Cloud team. Using the multimodal capabilities of , GoWish is now able to analyze and classify product information using images and text descriptions from source URLs. GoWish uses Gemini Embedding 001 and its multimodal features to generate dense vector embeddings, which act as the unique digital fingerprint for the "GoWish products," accurately identifying, categorizing, and grouping together billions of individual links.
